captions.caption: A person in black stands in a jungle.
The person cuts a vine with a machete.
The person pulls the cut vine down.
The person continues pulling the vine.
The person swings the machete at branches.
The person reaches for more vines.
The person chops a thick vine.
The person pulls greenery from above.
The person gathers vines in their hand.
The person inspects the length of vines.
The person cuts a piece from the vine.
The person bends down to the floor.
The person places vines on the ground.
The person clears leaves from a patch.
The person pushes aside debris with hands.
The person picks up a vine segment.
The person peels the vine with a blade.
The person strips the vine's outer layer.
The person checks the vine's flexibility.
The person trims the vine while standing.
The person holds the vine segment.
The person makes a loop at one end.
The person tests the vine loop's strength.
The person kneels to work on the ground.
The person positions the vine snare.
The person anchors the vine with a stick.
The person adjusts the snare placement.
The person pushes a stake into the earth.
The person ties the vine to the stake.
The person sets the trap trigger mechanism.
Hands work with vine and dirt.
The person adjusts the snare tension.
The person places twigs around the trap.
The person camouflages the snare.
A close-up shows leaf litter on the floor.
Insects crawl on dry forest leaves.
The camera focuses on ground details.
Hands return to make final adjustments.
The person tests the trap trigger.
The person pulls back from the set trap.
The person looks at the completed snare.
The person covers the trap with leaves.
The person scatters leaves over the vine.
The person smooths the leaf layer.
The person stands up from the ground.
The person picks up the machete.
The person looks around the jungle.
The person walks through thick brush.
The person clears a path with the blade.
The person navigates between trees.
The person moves deeper into vegetation.
The person reaches a mossy tree.
The person checks the ground by the tree.
The person digs into the soil at the base.
The person clears roots with the machete.
The person reaches into the dug hole.
The person extracts an object from the dirt.
The person inspects the found object.
The person cleans the object with fingers.
The person continues digging at the tree.
